turns.question: Could you have used Harvey when writing the Overton Papers?

answer.text:
Here is what the materials placed in this library support.

The Tennessee Reports: Overton and Thomas Emerson published the first two Tennessee Reports volumes in 1813–1817. The reports collected decisions of Tennessee's highest courts.

The archival Overton Papers: The Tennessee State Library and Archives finding aid describes the Murdock Collection of John Overton Papers as correspondence and other records, including legal and land business. Overton's papers are not the title of a single law book.

Harvey: research and human verification: Harvey describes legal research that retrieves authoritative legal sources and presents citations lawyers can open. Its account keeps the lawyer responsible for checking authorities and conclusions. This is Harvey's description of its workflow, not an independent test or a claim of infallibility.

Imagined reflection: I would have welcomed help finding authorities, and still asked to inspect them. This is a modern counterfactual, not a historical quotation.

citations.title: GoWipe · Overview
citations.text:
Delivered and live
Web developer since 2021
GoWipe sells bamboo wipes for specific uses: face, baby, pet, travel, food-safe and more. I have been the company's web developer since January 2021.
The problem
GoWipe sells one idea in several variants, and each variant answers a different need. A shopper has to tell a facial wipe from a pet wipe within seconds, usually on a phone. The business also advertises, so every step from viewing a product to buying it has to be reported consistently, or the spend cannot be judged.
What I built
I run the storefront on Shopify, starting from a commercial theme and customizing it with section code. The home page introduces the range by use, with social video, a comparison and reviews. Product pages offer one-time and subscription purchases, a sticky add-to-cart, and the ingredient story.
For measurement, the storefront reports the full shopping funnel to Google Analytics and Google Ads, from viewing a product through to purchase, with each event mapped to a conversion.
